why: Eleven argo pages, linewatch and console each hand-roll a pill bar that overflows on phones; a data-driven FilterSet with a measured fold and a Filters (n) sheet replaces them.
what: packages/basalt-ui/src/controls/filter-set*. The 2.x filter-set.tsx is rewritten in place and its test retargeted here; filter-pill and filter-sheet stay as donors.
must_not_touch: CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATING.md, llms.txt, scripts/check-budgets/** except areas/surface.ts, other areas' migrations files
contract: Frozen: ARCHITECTURE.md, this domain's contract.ts, src/core/ports.ts. Need a change: factory signal, take the reversible default. Read concepts/controls-url-state.md sections 3, 5, 9, 10 and evidence/gap-global-local-control-scope.md section 3 (prototype API). src/core/ports.ts owns ControlHandle and ControlsSlot. Primitives come only as basalt-ui/ui/<name>; date-picker by dynamic import. Strings: useMessages, English defaults in your owned src/core/messages/filters.ts (qa-i2 seeds it). Invariants: section 7 FilterSet row (pill prints the value even at default, off-catalogue value still renders, multi complete equals empty, no nested pills, Filters (n) stable with hidden surfaces).
exemplar: 2.x donors stay: src/controls/filter-set.tsx, filter-pill.tsx, filter-sheet.tsx and tests. Anatomy: src/controls/{control-view,control-home}* (ctl-4, ctl-4b; read in the tree).
change: FilterSet({specs}) default home pill: pills in one nowrap row, +N fold (measured, SSR-clipped row), below @narrow a 'Filters (n)' button opening a row-form sheet; never scroll, never wrap; pill prints the value; census via useActiveCount and a Reset all button; keys controls.moreFilters, showMore. useControlName gives pill name = control name with value as text. Rule: control-home (ctl-8) flags a raw Select as filter. Skill: generated docs/filter-set.md with the spec(...) example. Tests: ported invariants, layout matrix, SSR post-hydrate fold (S3). A new public value symbol also lands, in this Issue, its raise in scripts/check-budgets/areas/surface.ts (the ceiling +1 and a `raises` row with from, to, consumer and repo) and its name in scripts/consumers.json (`<symbol>: <repo>:<path>`); make check refuses the symbol without them. The shard is scripts/export-surface/controls.json, written by `export-surface.mjs --update`.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Layout and axe tests under tests/layout/ on a fixture host (tests/layout/fixture/) at 1440, 768, 390, 320; screenshots of the fixture host taken by the layout test (1800x1200 and 390x844, dark and light, at most 3 rounds) and named in the PR body. Long labels and 8 filters.
acceptance: layout at 1440, 768, 390 and 320 with long labels, 8 filters and 0 filters: no wrap, no horizontal scroll, Filters (n) count stable
SSR then hydrate: zero recoverable errors and no sibling layout shift after the fold (S3)
a pill prints the VALUE at its default; an off-catalogue value still renders; an archived option is disabled, not omitted
a multi selection equal to the full set behaves as empty (argo exercises)
axe zero serious or critical with the sheet open; 44 px hit floor on coarse
no nested pill: a folded pill opens as a row (test)
git diff --name-only lists only owned paths
out_of_scope: ControlView (ctl-4), ViewTabs, FormField, table filter chips (table-t3), saved views.
